data.title: software/: BRANDING.md — Innovative Communication ray-traced album-sleeve direction (band Software, 1980s)

data.body:
Review (self-review: sub-agent spawning is disabled in this session, so the fresh-context review gate could not be honoured — flagging rather than claiming an independent review).

Reviewed software/BRANDING.md (624 lines) against the plan's acceptance criteria.

PASS:
- Brief is buildable without further research: reference identified as Software, 'Past-Present-Future Vol. 2' (IC, 1987, graphics Franke/Helbig), discography graphics credits (MAPART/Peitgen, Nelson Max, Kawaguchi, Abel Image Research) verified against the rice.de SOFTWARE catalog.
- All 19 hexes are declared tokens in a :root block, split paper (type) vs plate (render-only).
- Contrast table computed per WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance, not guessed: ink 16.5, ink-2 6.4, indigo 10.7, amber-lo 6.8, coral 3.1 (fails body), chrome 2.5 (fails), white-on-lacquer 19.7.
- Checkable law present: border-radius is 0 or 50%, nothing between (s5) + a scripted test in s9.
- Build-contract legality checked snippet by snippet: @import at top with ';' percent-encoded as %3B; only @import/@media/@keyframes/@font-face; no head <link>; no commas in functional pseudo-classes (hover/focus-visible written separately); no display on html/body; ids and keyframes prefixed 'software-'; isolation: isolate specified; no position: fixed; no local assets (all gradients + data URIs).

FIXED INLINE DURING REVIEW (3):
1. s6 sizing was 'min(92vw, 92svh * 1, 1040px)' — dropped the pointless '* 1'.
2. s9 test 2 ('no non-inset box-shadow') contradicted the s3.6 registration flourish, which is a non-inset box-shadow. Test now allow-lists that one element by class.
3. s9 claimed the viewport bucket was unmapped and suggested 1100. Wrong — sites.config.json already maps "700": "software" (uncommitted, not mine; left untouched per shared-worktree discipline). Rewrote the bucket note for 700-799px, added the consequence that the type column is only ~220px wide there so the wordmark sits at --t-lg not --t-xl, and updated the catalogue micro string from 'IC · 1100' to 'IC · 0700'.

DISCOVERED, OUT OF SCOPE: 'node build.js' currently fails ('no <body> found in software/index.html') because the 700 bucket is mapped while software/index.html is still an empty scaffold. Noted in the brief; the page generation is a separate task.

Scope verified: only software/BRANDING.md changed. sites.config.json's software->700 line and the build.js commit da78cb3 are another agent's work and were left alone.

Meets acceptance criteria.
